extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, classification clerks, IP attorneys, patent applicants (for classifying goods and articles)
extracted.subtask_description: A taxonomy/listing of goods and articles organized by class/subclass for use in patent/trademark classification (goods/articles indexing). It enumerates classes (apparel, footwear, haberdashery, travel goods, brushware, textiles, furnishing, etc.) and detailed example items included in each class.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 02-02: Apparel (garments and specialised clothing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists types of garments and specialised clothing items: surgery apparel, sweaters, tippets, training clothes, trousers, trunks (bathing), ballet outfits, two-piece costumes (women's), ulsters, vests, infants' sleeved garments, waistcoats, warming garments, waterproof coats, wind jackets, working clothes, collarettes, collets, robes de chambre, peignoirs, salopettes, elastic tricot garments, isothermic garments (e.g., for underwater fishing), fur garments, funeral garments, heating garments, gymnastic swimsuits, nurse costumes, work blouses, overalls, pardessus, pants, ponchos, pullovers, raincoats, ceremonial togas, sailor garments, negligees, shorts, skirts, brassieres, stoles, camisoles, bathing costumes, surgeons' outfits, training wear, and numerous infant clothing items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This class enumerates both general and highly specialized garment types (by use, material, or user: e.g., infants, surgical, diving/isothermic). Use to classify articles of clothing and garments according to type and intended use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 02-04: Footwear, socks and stockings
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerates footwear and related items: ballet shoes for dancing and gymnastics, reflecting bands for feet, bath sandals, bootees (infants), boots (including ankle/half/sports/skiing/mountaineering), canvas rope-soled shoes, clogs, dancing shoes/pumps, elastic surgical hose and stockings, football boots, gaiters, galoshes, half-boots, heel protectors, insoles, innersoles, knee pads, leggings (including infants'), medical stockings, moccasins, overshoes (rubber), snow shoes, special shoes for persons with plaster casts, shoe heels, soles, uppers, slippers, socks, stockings (elastic/medical), tights, toe caps, shoe decorations and protectors, and related accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes footwear types, protective footwear, medical/therapeutic stockings and accessories (insoles, heel protectors), and special footwear for sports or medical needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 02-07: Haberdashery and clothing accessories
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers small items and accessories for clothing and sewing: arm bands (including fluorescent), darning balls/frames, belt trimmings, brassards, bobbins for embroidery, bows/ribbons for wear, braces/suspenders, brassieres wires, buckles, busks (corset parts), buttons, circular knitting needles, scarf clips (except jewelry), epaulets, eyelets (for haberdashery and shoes), fasteners (haberdashery, shoe, zip), feathers for dress ornament, fluorescent belts for pedestrians, frames for darning/embroidery, garters, hat bands, linings, netting pins, pin cushions, safety pins, scarf clips, thimbles, threaders, tie clips, zips/slide fasteners, sequins/spangles/paillettes, stiffeners for collars, sewing needles (including shoemakers' needles), crochet hooks, knitting needles, lace, ribbons, trimmings, and many other notions and sewing/haberdashery supplies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Class groups small wearable accessories, sewing/repair implements, decorative trimmings and fastening devices. Useful for classifying fasteners, sewing tools, trims, and accessory hardware.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 03: Travel goods, cases, parasols & personal belongings (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level category for trunks, suitcases, briefcases, handbags, wallets and similar articles, plus parasols/umbrellas, sunshades, walking sticks, personal containers and cases, and miscellaneous personal luggage and carrying devices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for articles designed to contain, protect or carry personal effects and specialised cases for instruments or items; includes walking aids and parasols where not classified elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 03-01: Trunks, suitcases, briefcases, handbags, wallets and similar articles (detailed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed listing of travel and carrying articles: bags (shopping, school, travelling, golf club, music, game), ball cases, baskets (work), billfolds, briefcases, lunch boxes with compartments, instrument cases, jewellery boxes, first aid kit containers, fobs/key rings, game bags, golf club bags, rucksacks/knapsacks, purses, reticules, portfolios (for drawings), money belts, net shopping bags, picnic boxes, sewing/manicure/shoe-cleaning/travel kits (containers), wallets, purses, satchels, haversacks, tool cases, vanity/toilet cases, passport/identity card cases, spectacle cases, tennis racket covers, typewriter cases, record player cases, camera/cine-camera cases and many containers designed specifically for particular contents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes both general-purpose luggage and specialised cases designed for particular contents (e.g., camera cases, instrument cases, passport/ID holders). Suitable for classifying containment articles by intended contents or use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 03-03: Umbrellas, parasols, sunshades and walking sticks; fans and related personal support items
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers umbrellas, parasols, parasol handles, umbrella ferrules, sliding collars of umbrellas, umbrella-sunshades, umbrella handles, parasols (garden/beach), fluorescent sheaths for walking sticks, walking sticks/canes (including seat-canes), crutches and crutch armrests, walking stick ferrules and tips, shooting sticks, and personal fans (handheld). Also lists related accessories (embouts, handles, sheaths) and personal support devices for infants (carry-cots, baby carriers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classifies personal shelters (umbrellas/parasols), walking/support aids and handheld fans. Includes both the devices and their accessory parts (handles, ferrules, sheaths).

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 04: Brushware (cleaning brushes, brooms, brushes for personal use and machines)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists brushes and brooms for cleaning (absorbent brushes, broom handles, brooms, crumb brushes, lavatory brushes, scouring brushes, feather dusters, furniture dusters, scrubbers, mop types), toilet brushes, clothes/hat/hand/soap brushes, nail polish brushes, shaving brushes, shoe brushes and daubers, toothbrushes, machine brushes, and painting/cooking brushes (and handles for these brushes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to classify cleaning implements, personal grooming brushes, machine brushes, and paint/cooking brushes; includes both brush heads and supporting handles/attachment devices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 05: Textile piece-goods, artificial and natural sheet material (overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerates textile materials and small textile articles: purls for embroidery, textile threads and yarns; lace, tulle and insertions; embroidery; ribbons, braids, decorative trimmings, elastic edgings, adhesive tapes; a wide variety of fabrics (brocades, calico, canvas, corduroy, crepe, crocheted fabrics, damask, dimity, elastic fabrics, felt, flannel, imitation fur, mesh, moquettes, netting, oilcloths, poplin, silk fabrics, ticking, tulle, twill, velvet cloth, woven fabrics, zephyr etc.); and sheet materials such as aluminium foil for household use, cork paper, laminates (paper/metal/plastic), kitchen paper rolls, linoleum, veneer sheets, self-adhesive plastic sheets, wax paper, wrapping material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classifies both finished fabrics and raw/processed sheet materials; covers decorative trimmings and narrow textile products as well as large-sheet materials used for covering/lining and packaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 05 (sheet materials specific): Artificial or natural sheet material and related products
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies sheets for covering and lining (wallpaper, linoleum), aluminium foil, cork paper, flint paper, kitchen paper rolls, laminates (paper/metal/plastic), cork paper, plastic self-adhesive sheets, veneer sheets, toilet/kitchen paper (rolls or dispensers), vulcanized paper, paper towels and wrapping sheets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this subset when classifying planar sheet materials primarily by composition and common household/industrial uses (coverings, linings, wraps, disposable paper goods).

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 06: Furnishing (furniture and household furnishings overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers furniture and household furnishing items including beds and seats (armchairs, babies' chairs, back supports, cots, beds, benches, bunk beds, camp beds, chairs, chaise longues, couches, divans, hospital and invalid beds, hammocks, headrests, cushions, ottomans, stools, rocking chairs, tractor/vehicle seats excluding saddles), tables and similar furniture (bedside tables, billiard tables, console tables, counters, desks, drawing and folding tables, laboratory tables, serving trolleys), and storage furniture (bathroom cabinets, bookcases, bottle racks, cupboards, cabinets for various uses, safes, shelves, chests, wardrobes, display cases).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for classification of furniture by function (seating, sleeping, tables/surfaces, storage), including specialised furniture (dental chairs, hospital beds, vehicle seats) and furniture with compartments/drawers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 06-01: Beds and seats (detailed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed listing of seating and sleeping furniture: armchairs, babies' chairs, back supports for motorists, basket cots, beds, benches, bunk beds, camp beds, dental chairs, chaise longues, couches for massage, cradles, dentists' chairs for medical use, divans, easy chairs, elbow rests for vehicle seats, fireside chairs, fold-down/folding seats, garden chairs, hairdressers' chairs, hammocks, headrests for seats, hospital/invalid beds, lawn swings, mattress supports, ottomans, poufs, rocking-chairs, school benches, folding seats for camping, tractor seats and other vehicle seats (except saddles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify seating/sleeping furniture including specialised medical or vehicular items in this subclass.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 06-03: Tables and similar furniture (detailed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes tables for bridge and games, changing tables for babies' napkins, bedside tables, billiard tables, console tables, shop counters, desks (including school desks and writing desks), drawing and folding tables, laboratory and pedestal tables, serving trolleys, work benches and other household/work tables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for furniture primarily functioning as raised surfaces for work, dining, display or specific activities (games, nursing, laboratory use).

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 06-04: Storage furniture (detailed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Storage-oriented furniture: bathroom cabinets (including medicine cabinets), bookcases, bookshelves, bottle racks for storage, cabinets (kitchen, music, religious, silver), chests, clothes racks, commodes, file cabinets, chests-of-drawers, closets, shelving (flower shelving, newspaper kiosk shelving), safe boxes, vitrines/display cases, wardrobes, pantries, shoe chests/boxes, sideboards, buffets, dressers, cupboards and many furniture items with compartments for specialised storage uses (phonograph discs, tools, crockery, bottles, weapons racks etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers furniture devices whose main purpose is storage or organized holding of items; includes both general furniture (cupboards, wardrobes) and specialised cabinets/holders (medicine cabinets, disc cabinets).
